name: popsicle
headline: aetherpost: ai social media promotion tool
short_description: AI-powered social media automation tool that generates and posts content across Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, Bluesky, and Instagram using declarative YAML configuration and OpenAI GPT.
author: fununnn

sections.overview:
AetherPost automates app promotion across five social media platforms using AI-generated content defined through Infrastructure-as-Code principles. Users configure campaigns in YAML, set API credentials in .env files, and deploy using Terraform-style commands (init, plan, apply). The tool supports 20+ languages, multiple content styles (casual, professional, technical, humorous), and optional Slack/LINE notifications for preview or auto-posting. AetherPost includes two setup modes: auto-setup for pre-configured files and interactive setup for manual configuration, making it accessible to developers automating marketing workflows without manual content creation.
Automating daily promotion posts across multiple platforms for open-source projects
Generating multi-language social media campaigns for international app launches
Scheduling platform-specific content with AI generation and preview notifications
Setting up zero-prompt social media automation with pre-configured YAML files
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/fununnn/aetherpost`
sections.usage:
```
Create a 7-day social media content calendar for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] using the following data: [DATA]. Include a mix of promotional posts, engaging questions, and industry news. Optimize for LinkedIn, Twitter, and Facebook.
```
